description:
## Finding

5 instances of `match Option { Some(x) => ..., None => ... }` or `if let Some(x) = ... else { ... }` patterns that clippy flags as `clippy::option_if_let_else`. Cleaner with `Option::map_or` / `map_or_else`.

## Locations

- pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1201 (`map_or_else` — closures over `Result`)
- pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1969 (the `nc_permitted/nc_excluded` initialization — interesting: cloning happens in the `Some` arm only)
- pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1991 (`nc_constrained_types`)
- pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:256 (`rsa_modulus_byte_len` check)
- pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:489 (`BasicConstraints` decode)

## Caveat

The pkix-path:1969 case is non-trivial — the `Some(nc) => ...` arm clones, and the comment says `// Clone necessary: nc_permitted and nc_excluded are mutated during the walk.`. Rewriting as `map_or_else(|| ..., |nc| ...)` works but the closure form is arguably less readable. Worth checking case-by-case.

## Priority

P4 — opinion. The cabf_tls_br.rs cases are clear wins; the pkix-path NC-init case is a judgment call.
title: P4: 5 if-let-else patterns could use Option::map_or / map_or_else
